automatedTest.name: end-to-end first-report journey proves repository selection commit capture recovery and saved success

states.expected: The platform folder picker hands one local path to Git validation before workspace creation.
The reopened saved report displays the exact repository commit captured by analysis.
A report empty state is rendered before any analysis exists.
Incomplete success checks block analysis without discarding the editable goal.
Cancellation returns to editable goals and keeps the approved goal available.
A provider failure shows source-free recovery guidance and preserves the goal.
Retry starts a new bounded analysis from the preserved goal set.
The saved report reopens with history and an evidence-grounded recommendation.
